summary: Customer unable to access loan balance online, agent assists.

intents.keywords: I tried checking my ... account not found help.
issues: Customer is unable to view loan balance online.
Account not found error on the online portal.
reasons (identified by agent): Account is not linked to the online portal.
actions of agent: Agent confirmed the loan account number.
Agent linked the account to the portal.
Agent promised to send login instructions.
Agent offered further assistance via call.
intents.resolution: Agent linked the customer's loan account to the online portal and provided login instructions and a guide.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent was polite, helpful, and reassuring.

intents.keywords: Ok but I am ... will it be easy?
issues: Customer is not comfortable with online platforms.
Customer is concerned about the ease of using the online portal.
actions of agent: Agent reassured the customer that the process is simple.
Agent offered further assistance via call.
intents.resolution: Agent reassured the customer about the simplicity of the online portal and offered a guide and further assistance.
intents.agent professionalism: The agent was patient and provided reassurance.
